name: Tomas Tobé - § 99 - Am 53
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 99. Welcomes the recognition in the 2025 US National Security Strategy that Europe remains strategically and culturally vital to the United States, that transatlantic trade is a pillar of mutual prosperity and that the United States needs a strong Europe; considers this a firm basis for renewed transatlantic cooperation between sovereign democratic allies;
